title: Sample 2-8: Publisher Website

illustrates.quote: c. Publisher’s Website. The publisher’s URL is included on the title page if it appears on the title page, copyright page, or cover of the book. Insert the website on the line after the publisher’s city/state. (See Sample 2-8: Publisher Website on page 2-31.)

print.notes: Print original is a photographic reproduction of a real book's cover/title/copyright/contents page (references/_gemini/gold-2-A/page-075.png), not encoded as running text anywhere in the source .txt. Neither independent transcription run modelled it into print.blocks (both left print.blocks empty); this reconciliation viewed the page image directly to confirm the braille.lines transcription and the sample's own title/rule citation, but likewise leaves print.blocks empty -- building a faithful print.blocks model of a photographed book cover is out of this reconciliation's scope (reconciling two existing transcription runs), not a disagreement between them to resolve.

resolution: braille.lines: A and B agree on content; A's version (kept here) retains the source's own leading/internal/trailing blank braille lines verbatim (confirmed by direct re-derivation from source-lines-1390-2934.txt), matching this gold corpus's established convention (see e.g. tests/gold/bana-formats-2016/section-5's own U+2800-filler-line handling); B's version silently strips those blank lines. illustrates.quote: A's quote was correctly scoped but had a stray mid-sentence page-footer line (a running head/page-number pair from the source's own page break) spliced into the middle or end of the text; removed here. B's own quote field was not used (it echoed the file's title, not the rule).
